caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick, rendered in pencil on a light beige background. The main view at the center shows the candlestick in full elevation, featuring a circular base, a slender, symmetrically contoured stem with several rounded and angular sections, and a wide, flat top designed to hold a candle. Two additional smaller diagrams are present: in the lower left is a top-down view showing concentric circles with dimensions noted, and in the lower right is a simplified side view with height and base width measurements marked ("21" and "24 1/8") next to the candlestick's outline. The composition is technical and precise, focusing on the structure, proportions, and dimensions of the candlestick without the use of color other than shades of grey for shading and contouring. The label "MEYERS" appears in the lower left corner, and the phrase "SCALE ½ IN" is written just above the center bottom of the drawing.
title: Candlestick
